why: The whole document is a request for a verdict and for immigration advice, so there is no resume to protect and nothing to quarantine out of it. This is the distinction the prompt turns on: out_of_scope is about what the document IS, while a resume that merely CONTAINS a sentence addressed to the reader is ok with that span quarantined.
